metadata.description: Claude Code skills for the unglamorous half of shipping: babysitting PRs to merge and writing PR descriptions a stranger can review.

plugins.name: babysit-pr
plugins.description: Drives a PR to merge: updates the branch, answers every review comment (bot or human), fixes CI, re-requests reviewers, and optionally watches until auto-merge lands it.

plugins.name: pr-description
plugins.description: Writes a PR body for an engineer who knows nothing about the task, then has a fresh subagent fact-check every claim against the diff before posting.
